task.description: Step 0.5 — Verify local issue registry entry 'docs/issues/ISS-0122.json' is current and the GitHub link is present. Issue 388 already references ISS-0122. Post a comment on GH #388 indicating the WF-03 run is starting (workflow_id WF03-gh388-20260802) and reference the local ISS file. Step 1 — Diagnose the C22021 'invalid byte sequence for encoding UTF8: 0xaa' failure. The hypothesis: when an InstanceStore.create call receives a JSON-shaped payload string, the bytes from struct padding or test layout reach the wire. Read the relevant code paths and confirm where the bytes can come from. Concretely: (1) Read src/engine/instance.zig `InstanceStore.create` (around line 468) — what is the type signature of `initial_variables` and how is it bound to $N? (2) Read the call site tests/integration/instance_error_test.zig:852 and confirm the literal text passed to inst_store.create. (3) Verify the actual byte 0xAA — its likely source is struct padding or a non-printable byte that came from the test (e.g. a stray buffer or copy from a prior failed transaction). It is NOT in the literal `{"foo":"bar"}` ASCII. Look at the broader test setup (helper fixtures, harness, scope layout). (4) Read `vendor/pg/pg.zig` around line 303 readUntilReady to confirm where raw bytes are flushed to the wire. (5) Formulate the precise root cause from code evidence (not from symptom only). Also: search docs/issues/issue_index.json for any prior resolved matching issue — there may be a sister issue whose root-cause is the same.

result.summary: Step 0.5 complete: verified docs/issues/ISS-0122.json (status=OPEN, github_issue=388), posted GH comment #5155985384 (https://github.com/tvolodi/R-Co/issues/388#issuecomment-5155985384), appended gh_comment_url field to ISS-0122.json. Step 1 complete: root cause is NOT a Zig-side byte injection (all bind sources in src/engine/instance.zig, src/engine/service_task.zig, src/obs/audit.zig, src/scheduler/scheduler.zig verified pure-ASCII). The 0xAA byte originates server-side inside audit_entries.resource_id (TEXT after GBL-081); the BEFORE INSERT trigger bpm_audit_apply_chain_hash (migrations/051_xc02_audit_immutability.sql) calls bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash (migrations/035_adp09_tamper_evident_audit_chain.sql) which still declares p_resource_id UUID. The implicit UUID cast or convert_to(..., 'UTF8') rejects when NEW.resource_id contains 0xAA. Interleaved C23503/C42703/C23514 errors in the same log regions confirm shared-DB-state contamination (sister issue ISS-0112). Fix: migrate bpm_audit_compute_chain_hash to accept p_resource_id TEXT (drop implicit UUID cast) and add tests/integration/audit_chain_utf8_test.zig regression test.
